General Vector Drawing — Free Browser-Based SVG Editor

Browser-based 2D CAD and vector drawing for diagrams and physical plans. Use closed profiles for fills, Boolean operations, and extrusion; use open routes for wiring or swept 3D geometry.

What you can do

  • Freeform vector drawing with closed-profile fills and open wire or route geometry
  • Union, Subtract, and Intersect for closed profiles; hole-preserving 3D extrusion
  • 3D route sweeps, parametric solids, imported meshes, and direct mesh-component editing
  • Layer management with visibility toggle and element locking
  • Group and ungroup with nested group support
  • Snap-to-grid and snap-to-object for precise placement
  • Export as SVG or JSON
